description: import: UTF-8 JSONL, one complete object per line, not a JSON array. record add/update: one JSON object (pretty printing allowed). import/add default to draft: omit entity IDs and the server allocates them. canonical: preserve existing Zygos IDs; record update requires a complete canonical record, not a partial patch or the record-show envelope. draft_schema_version is 1.0.0 and record schema_version is 2.0.0. Shared prompts go in contents; responses go in candidates[].contents with role ai, not assistant. Use --file - for stdin. Create the named dataset before importing. Invalid input returns field paths, hints and a valid example; no valid prefix is published.
usage: zygos dataset record add demo --file record.json
zygos dataset import demo --file exported.jsonl --format canonical
